headline: KaggleARC climbs 37 places to 98th on ARC-AGI-2

sections.text: KaggleARC climbed 37 places, from 135th to 98th, with a score of 34.86, up 1.80 in the past day.
The move takes KaggleARC inside the top 100 on a board of 3,223 teams.
